findings.fix: Extract the general lemma, e.g. `private theorem map_pairReindex_eq_self_of_forall_finset {ρ : Measure (ℕ × ℕ → α)} [IsFiniteMeasure ρ] {σ τ : Equiv.Perm ℕ} (h : ∀ F : Finset (ℕ × ℕ), ∃ σ' τ' : Equiv.Perm ℕ, (ρ.map fun (x : ℕ × ℕ → α) (p : ℕ × ℕ) => x (σ' p.1, τ' p.2)) = ρ ∧ ∀ p ∈ F, σ' p.1 = σ p.1 ∧ τ' p.2 = τ p.2) : (ρ.map fun (x : ℕ × ℕ → α) (p : ℕ × ℕ) => x (σ p.1, τ p.2)) = ρ`, and derive both: the joint case instantiates it with `(π, π)` for the finitary `π` agreeing with `σ` on `F.image Prod.fst ∪ F.image Prod.snd` (the invariance witness is the existing `hτinv` block, lines 79-91), the separate case with `(σ', τ')` as at lines 124-134.
findings.issue: `separatelyExchangeable_of_finitary` (lines 111-144) duplicates the determinacy argument of the existing `jointlyExchangeable_of_smulInvariantMeasure` (lines 64-101): `hmeas`, the `map_eq_iff_forall_finset_map_restrict_eq` rewrite, the `exists_finite_compl_fixedBy_apply_eq_on_finset` choice, the `heq` restrict-agreement and the final `rwa` are the same proof with one permutation replaced by two. Both statements are special cases of the pair-form lemma, which the new proof already contains inline.

summary: Statement-level generality is sound: hypotheses are used and minimal, the corner-tail invariance lemma is properly generalized with the diagonal case derived, and the mixture construction is correctly factored over an arbitrary property of the conditional laws. The one issue is that the new finitary-testing lemma re-proves the finite-dimensional determinacy argument that the existing diagonal lemma already contains, instead of both being derived from the pair-form general lemma.
